title: Algebraic Immunity of the Large-Scale χ Operation
summary: No efficient method is known to compute algebraic immunity for a huge S-box; efficiently computing or characterizing it for the large-scale χ operation remains open.

formal_statement.body: Find an efficient algorithm to compute or characterize the algebraic immunity of the large-scale $\chi$ operation.

scope.domain: The domain is algebraic cryptanalysis of the large-scale χ Boolean S-box in Rasta and Dasta.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Develop an efficient algorithm to compute or characterize the algebraic immunity of the large-scale χ operation.

citations.label: Algebraic Attacks on Rasta and Dasta Using Low-Degree Equations

progress.summary: The paper presents the large-scale χ operation as a huge Boolean S-box and notes that no efficient method is known to compute its algebraic immunity. Efficient computation or characterization remains unresolved.
citation_labels: Fukang Liu et al., Algebraic Attacks on Rasta and Dasta Using Low-Degree Equations
